name: kuan
description: KuanAI free agent skills: 25 SKILL.md skills for coding, writing, research and business. Install one at a time: /plugin install <skill>@kuan

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Reviews a diff for bugs it has verified in the code, ranks them by severity and gives a failing scenario and minimal fix for each.

plugins.name: commit-message
plugins.description: Writes a commit message that matches the repo's conventions and explains why, then commits safely without skipping hooks or staging secrets.

plugins.name: pr-description
plugins.description: Writes a PR title and description from the real diff, filling the repo's template, with test steps you actually ran and risks called out.

plugins.name: write-tests
plugins.description: Writes tests in the project's own framework, proves each one fails when the behavior breaks, and reports bugs instead of encoding them.

plugins.name: debug-detective
plugins.description: Finds the root cause of a bug by reproducing it, narrowing with evidence and bisecting, then fixes the cause with a regression test.

plugins.name: refactor-safely
plugins.description: Restructures code in small verified steps that keep tests, types and public behavior intact, and flags any change that is not a pure refactor.

plugins.name: readme-writer
plugins.description: Writes or updates a README with commands verified against the repo, real env vars and setup steps that get a newcomer running fast.

plugins.name: sql-helper
plugins.description: Writes, checks and speeds up SQL against your real schema, catching NULL and join fan-out bugs and guarding every write with a preview and transaction.

plugins.name: api-docs
plugins.description: Documents HTTP endpoints by tracing routes, middleware and validators in the code, so params, auth and error codes match what the server really does.

plugins.name: dockerize
plugins.description: Adds a Dockerfile, .dockerignore and compose file matched to your stack, then builds and runs the container to prove it starts and responds.

plugins.name: changelog
plugins.description: Turns a git range into user-facing release notes with breaking changes and migration steps first, each item traceable to its commit or PR.

plugins.name: security-check
plugins.description: Finds exploitable security bugs in a repo or diff by tracing user input to dangerous sinks, ranked by real risk with file:line and a fix.

plugins.name: meeting-notes
plugins.description: Turns a transcript into decisions, action items with owner and date, and open questions, without inventing owners, dates or agreements.

plugins.name: email-replier
plugins.description: Drafts email replies that answer every question in order, never commit you to anything you did not approve, and mark missing facts as placeholders.

plugins.name: seo-article
plugins.description: Writes a search-intent-matched article that answers the query first, adds original substance, and never invents statistics, sources or links.

plugins.name: research-brief
plugins.description: Researches a question with primary sources, a clear stop rule and exact citations, and returns a short brief that says what is known, disputed and unknown.

plugins.name: competitor-analysis
plugins.description: Compares competitors on audience, price, features and real customer complaints, with a source and date for every cell, and finds the gap you can own.

plugins.name: data-analyst
plugins.description: Analyzes a CSV or spreadsheet with code, checks data quality and reconciles totals, and answers with verified numbers, caveats and the findings that matter.

plugins.name: product-spec
plugins.description: Turns a feature idea into a one-page spec with problem, scope, acceptance criteria, edge cases and a measurable goal, marking every assumption.

plugins.name: support-reply
plugins.description: Drafts support replies that fix the issue within your policies, never claim actions not taken, and flag tickets that need a human or escalation.

plugins.name: migration-safety
plugins.description: Writes and reviews schema migrations that run without downtime: expand/contract steps, lock checks, batched backfills, deploy order and a rollback plan.

plugins.name: ci-failure-fix
plugins.description: Diagnoses a red CI pipeline from the real logs, separates flaky tests from real failures, reproduces locally and fixes the cause without skipping checks.

plugins.name: dependency-upgrade
plugins.description: Upgrades a library or framework major version step by step: reads the changelog and migration guide, fixes removed APIs and keeps the tests green.

plugins.name: incident-postmortem
plugins.description: Turns incident logs, chat and notes into a blameless postmortem with a verified timeline, root cause, contributing factors and owned action items.

plugins.name: eval-prompt
plugins.description: Builds a small test set with pass/fail criteria for a prompt, skill or agent, runs it before and after a change and reports what really improved.
